task_message:
Case M14: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 220x220x300 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case M14 is finished.

**Summary of the segmentation:**
- **Finding:** a well-circumscribed, markedly hyperintense (T2) oval soft-tissue mass in the thigh, located in the subcutaneous/deep fascial plane on the lateral aspect, extending over ~53 mm craniocaudally with a maximum cross-section of ~30 × 25 mm.
- **Method:** localized the lesion on axial contact sheets, seeded it with a positive point inside the mass (mark 860), verified and re-fit the boundary in all three orthogonal planes, applied a 1 mm dilation to include the full bright periphery/capsule, and reviewed the five-slice-per-plane final check.
- **Mask:** single connected component, 22.9 mL (extent axial 189–242, coronal 69–99, sagittal 58–92).
- **Candidates rejected:** the automatic proposals traced long curved/tubular structures (fascial planes, vessels) and a thin rim of adjacent fat, not tumor tissue.
- **Confidence:** medium — the boundary follows the visible hyperintense mass in all planes, though the lesion edge is slightly blurred on this fat-saturated T2 acquisition.
